page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text. Above the text: a decorative woodcut border strip. Then a running title-like line in italic, a centred heading in capitals, a centred line with "S. P. D.", then the body text beginning with a large decorated initial. Page number at the foot.

main_text.head: Johannes Buxtorfius
JOH. GOSVINI BOS- MANNO, Dordraceno, Phil. M. & JACOBO GUILHELMI HOOFT, Amsteldamensi,
main_text.p: EN vobis, ornatissimi & doctissimi Viri, (sic enim liceat mihi vos compellare, quòd Virtus in Vobis virile sit consecuta robur) en, inquam, vobis, quòd sæpè desideratis, breve in universa Biblia Hebraica Lexicon, ad id tantummodo elaboratum, ut significata omnium vocum Biblicarum, subito intuitu menti offerat. page.notes: The initial "E" is a large woodcut letter, joined to the word "EN" as printed. The page number "2" is set at the foot beside a bracket mark ")(". The top border is an ornamental woodcut band, not text. The word "Johannes Buxtorfius" is in italic. Some words in the scan are slightly blurred ("Dordraceno", "Amsteldamensi") but read plausibly.
